text: Rooms protected by gaseous extinguishing (control room floor voids, electronic rooms, cable rooms, GT enclosure per the fire protection concept, CO2 / inert gas per NFPA 12) shall have their ventilation dampers closing before the discharge and a post-discharge purge extraction of at least 6 air changes per hour started manually after the fire brigade has confirmed the extinguishing; the room shall not be pressurised during the discharge.
